label: SCENARIOS
disclaimer: These are hypothetical pathways for discussion — not predictions or forecasts.

scenarios.title: Support remains concentrated
scenarios.summary: Eligible expenditure and offsets cluster among a smaller set of larger news-business groups, even while meeting formal minimums.

scenarios.title: Support reaches a broader range
scenarios.summary: Commercial deals and/or payment-scheme flows extend across a wider mix of news-business corporate groups.

scenarios.title: Smaller / regional / independent publishers become more sustainable
scenarios.summary: Resources reach newsrooms that expand local, community and public-interest capacity over time.
